Sunday School

Sunday School serves as the primary discipleship hub of FBC.

Through our age-appropriate classes, everyone is invited to fellowship and study God’s Word.

Our Sunday School classes typically study through a book of the Bible, a biblically-based series, or use one of Lifeway's quarterly curriculums.

Sunday School Classes
Every Class • Every Sunday • 9:45am

Adult Classes

Our adult classes equip men and women from all walks of life with a knowledge of God's Word. No matter who you are, you'll find a Sunday School class where you belong.

Youth Classes

Our youth classes (Grades 6-12) are designed specifically for teenagers to gain a deep understanding of God's Word and see how it makes a difference in their everyday life.

Youth Classes meet at The Underground

Children's Classes

Kids will find a warm, fun, and safe environment ready for them every Sunday with teachers who love Jesus and show His love and His word to them.

Preschool classes are birth - Pre-K.
Elementary classes are K - Grade 5.

For a full list of classes, stop by our Welcome Center in the foyer.

Steve Putney
Director of Discipleship
